Alice —

Attached: vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet). I also attached a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf) — redactions: customer names and PII removed.

High-level answers to your KMS/HSM questions to speed things up:

- Key residency: For Hosted customers we can provision keys in a specific cloud region (e.g., eu-west-1) when using customer-managed KMS. For Private deployments keys remain under customer control on-prem or in their VPC.
- At-rest encryption: AES-256 with envelope encryption; root key can be a customer-managed CMK.
- In-transit: TLS 1.2/1.3 with mutual TLS available for Private deployments.
- HSM support: We support AWS CloudHSM and external HSM integrations for Dedicated/Private. We can accept encrypted key import (BYOK) or integrate with customer KMS over a secure peering/VPN.
- Rotation: CMK rotation policies configurable; we recommend 90–365 day rotation depending on risk profile — we can surface rotation logs in the audit trail.

If it helps, I can have our security architect join the technical call to walk the FinBank infra team through the HSM/KMS integration details. Would Wed 10/14 10am PT work?

Thanks — next steps: you confirm the call time and any high-priority questionnaire rows.

Best,
